context: Go port of a Python MCP memory server. The port is ~70% complete. This document lists every issue found during audit, grouped by priority. Fix all items before merge to main.
repo_structure_hint: cmd/agent-memory/main.go is entrypoint. internal/mcp/ has MCP server+tools. internal/httpapi/ has REST API. internal/store/sqlite/ has DB layer. internal/sessions/ has session recall system. internal/memory/service.go is the service layer.

blockers.title: go.mod declares go 1.26.0 which does not exist
blockers.problem: go 1.26.0 is not a real Go version. No toolchain can build this module.
blockers.fix: Change to 'go 1.23' or 'go 1.24' (whatever version you have installed). Run 'go mod tidy' after.

blockers.title: 8 MCP tools not registered — agents lose half their capabilities
blockers.problem: Only 10 of 18 MCP tools are registered. Missing: global_search, get_pattern_report, get_related_memories, find_similar_failures, failure_hotspots, memory_feedback, recall_sessions, list_sessions. The service methods exist but the tools are not wired up.
blockers.fix: Add tool registrations in server_tools.go for each missing tool. Follow the same pattern as existing tools (define Tool schema + handler). For global_search: call service.GlobalSearch(query, limit). For failure_hotspots: call service.FailureHotspots(limit). For memory_feedback: call service.RecordFeedback(memoryId, useful). For get_pattern_report: call service.GetPatternReport(repoId). For get_related_memories: call service.GetRelatedMemories(memoryId, limit). For find_similar_failures: call service.FindSimilarFailures(repoId, limit). For recall_sessions and list_sessions: see item B3.

blockers.title: Cross-tool session recall not implemented (the key differentiating feature)
blockers.problem: The session subsystem only has a markdown parser. It cannot read Claude Code JSONL (~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl) or Codex CLI JSONL (~/.codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl). No search endpoints exist. The recall_sessions and list_sessions MCP tools are missing.

fix_steps.details: Claude Code JSONL format: each line is JSON with 'type' field (user/assistant/summary) and 'message.content' field containing content blocks. Each block has a 'type' (text/thinking/tool_use/tool_result). Normalize blocks to plain text: extract 'text' from text blocks, '[thinking]' prefix for thinking blocks, 'tool_use: <tool_name>(<truncated_input>)' for tool_use, truncated result for tool_result. Truncate tool_result to 600 chars, tool_input to 160 chars. Extract timestamp from 'message.created_at' or fall back to file mtime. Return []SessionTurn.

fix_steps.description: Add Claude Code and Codex adapters in internal/sessions/adapters/adapter.go
fix_steps.details: Add two new built-in adapters: claude_code with glob '~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl' and format 'jsonl', codex with glob '~/.codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl' and format 'jsonl'. Keep the existing markdown adapter for Cursor. The adapter struct already has Name, SessionGlobs, Format fields — just add entries to the builtins list.

fix_steps.description: Update internal/sessions/index.go to use JSONL parser
fix_steps.details: In the indexer's file parsing logic, check the adapter format. If 'jsonl', use the new JSONL parser. If 'markdown', use existing markdown parser. Add mtime-based caching so files are not re-parsed if unchanged.

fix_steps.description: Add recall_sessions and list_sessions MCP tools
fix_steps.details: recall_sessions: params are query(string), source(string, optional filter by tool name), limit(int, default 20). Search indexed session turns, return ranked results with source/project/timestamp. list_sessions: params are source(string, optional), limit(int, default 20). Return session metadata — file path, tool name, project, turn count, last modified time.

GET /api/sessions — list discovered sessions. POST /api/sessions/search — search session turns (body: {query, source, limit}). POST /api/sessions/ingest — promote a turn to permanent memory (body: {session_file, turn_index, kind}).

blockers.reference_implementation: See https://github.com/Kuberwastaken/reference — specifically reference_mcp/normalize.py for JSONL parsing logic and reference_mcp/adapters.py for adapter config. Our plan doc is at docs/CROSS_TOOL_SESSION_RECALL.md in this repo.

high_severity_bugs.title: search_memory score hardcoded to 0.0
high_severity_bugs.problem: The search result formatting uses a hardcoded 0.0 score instead of the actual score from the search result. Every result shows [0.00] to the agent.
high_severity_bugs.fix: The search results from the store layer return a score field. Pass it through to the MCP response formatting. Look at how the store's Search() method returns results and extract the score from each hit.

high_severity_bugs.title: RecordAccess never called during searches
high_severity_bugs.problem: The service's Search/GlobalSearch methods never call store.RecordAccess() for returned memories. Access tracking is the foundation of relevance scoring — without it, relevance scores never update and noise classification has no data.
high_severity_bugs.fix: After Search() returns results, iterate over them and call store.RecordAccess(memoryID, 'search') for each result. Do the same in GlobalSearch() and GetRepoContext().

high_severity_bugs.title: Session FTS DELETE runs after rows already deleted
high_severity_bugs.problem: Line 42 deletes from session_turns table. Lines 45-46 try to delete from session_turns_fts WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM session_turns WHERE session_id=?). But the rows are already gone, so the subquery returns nothing. Stale FTS entries accumulate forever causing phantom search results.
high_severity_bugs.fix: Swap the order: delete from FTS first (while rows still exist to subquery against), then delete from the main table. Or collect the rowids before deleting, then use them in the FTS delete.

medium_severity_bugs.title: MemoryServiceFromContext nil panic
medium_severity_bugs.problem: If auth middleware is bypassed or context key is missing, MemoryServiceFromContext returns nil. Every HTTP handler then panics on nil pointer dereference.
medium_severity_bugs.fix: Add a nil check. If MemoryServiceFromContext returns nil, respond with 500 Internal Server Error instead of panicking. Or add a middleware that rejects requests without a service in context.

medium_severity_bugs.title: Session turn ID corrupts after 127 turns
medium_severity_bugs.problem: Uses string(rune(len(turns))) to generate turn IDs. After 127 turns this produces multi-byte UTF-8 characters. At 0 it produces a null byte.
medium_severity_bugs.fix: Replace with strconv.Itoa(len(turns)) or fmt.Sprintf('%d', len(turns)).

medium_severity_bugs.title: Custom min() function collides with Go 1.21+ builtin
medium_severity_bugs.problem: Go 1.21 added a builtin min(). This custom definition will cause compile error or shadowing warning.
medium_severity_bugs.fix: Delete the custom min function. Use the builtin min() (if targeting Go 1.21+) or rename to minInt().

medium_severity_bugs.title: handleExport writes partial response on error
medium_severity_bugs.problem: After writing the first JSONL line (HTTP 200 already sent), if encoder.Encode fails, http.Error is called but cannot change the status code. Client gets corrupt partial JSONL with a 200 status.
medium_severity_bugs.fix: Buffer the entire response before writing, or log the error and break (since status is already sent). Alternatively, use chunked encoding and just abort the stream.

medium_severity_bugs.title: Watcher ignores all dot-directories
medium_severity_bugs.problem: isIgnoredDir skips any directory starting with '.'. This means ~/.claude/ and ~/.codex/ would be skipped, making JSONL session ingestion from those paths impossible.
medium_severity_bugs.fix: Only ignore specific dot-directories (.git, .svn, node_modules, __pycache__) instead of all dot-prefixed directories. Or make the session indexer bypass the watcher entirely and use its own glob-based file discovery.

low_severity_bugs.title: FTS and vector search errors silently swallowed
low_severity_bugs.problem: Both FTS and vector query use 'rows, _ := ...' ignoring errors. A broken FTS index returns zero results with no error indication.
low_severity_bugs.fix: Handle the error. At minimum log it. Ideally return it so callers know search degraded.

low_severity_bugs.title: Usage Summary and ListSessions are empty stubs
low_severity_bugs.problem: These methods return hardcoded empty data and never query the database. The /api/usage/summary endpoint returns nothing useful.
low_severity_bugs.fix: Implement actual queries against usage.db. Summary should return total interactions, unique repos, top tools. ListSessions should query usage_sessions table.

low_severity_bugs.title: Deprecated ioutil usage
low_severity_bugs.problem: Uses ioutil.ReadFile, ioutil.ReadDir, ioutil.WriteFile — deprecated since Go 1.16.

low_severity_bugs.title: GetRelatedMemories is a stub
low_severity_bugs.problem: GetRelatedMemories just calls ListMemories — it does not actually find related memories by content similarity.
low_severity_bugs.fix: Implement actual related memory finding: take the source memory's content, run a search query with it, exclude the source memory from results.

low_severity_bugs.title: GetPatternReport returns hardcoded data
low_severity_bugs.problem: Returns a hardcoded dictionary instead of computing real patterns from the database.
low_severity_bugs.fix: Query failure_signatures grouped by signature, count occurrences, compute health score based on resolved vs unresolved ratio. The Python version in patterns/detector.py has the logic.

low_severity_bugs.title: FailureHotspots missing repo path lookup
low_severity_bugs.problem: Returns '/placeholder' for repo paths instead of actual paths from repos table.
low_severity_bugs.fix: JOIN with repos table or look up repo path after querying failure counts.

low_severity_bugs.title: handleWatcherStart and handleWatcherStop are no-ops
low_severity_bugs.problem: Return hardcoded JSON without actually starting or stopping the watcher.
low_severity_bugs.fix: Wire up to the actual watcher service. Call watcher.Start(path) and watcher.Stop().

low_severity_bugs.title: Embeddings are 64-dim hash vectors, not real 384-dim
low_severity_bugs.problem: Uses a naive bag-of-words hash vector (64 dimensions) instead of real sentence-transformer embeddings (384 dimensions). Search quality is significantly lower than the Python version.
low_severity_bugs.fix: This is a known limitation for the Go port. Options: (a) call an embedding API (OpenAI/local), (b) use ONNX runtime to run all-MiniLM-L6-v2 locally, (c) accept the tradeoff for now and document it. Recommend option (c) for initial release, (a) as a fast follow.

missing_features_not_blocking_merge.title: WebSocket events not implemented
missing_features_not_blocking_merge.problem: The routes_ws.go file exists and registers /ws/events but the actual WebSocket upgrade and event broadcasting is not fully wired. The Python version streams real-time events to the dashboard.
missing_features_not_blocking_merge.note: Not a merge blocker if the dashboard works without live updates. Can be added post-merge.

missing_features_not_blocking_merge.title: No TOML config for custom session sources
missing_features_not_blocking_merge.problem: The plan called for ~/.agent-memory/session_sources.toml to let users add custom tool adapters (e.g. Windsurf). Currently only hardcoded adapters exist.
missing_features_not_blocking_merge.note: Nice-to-have. Add after core session recall works.

verification_checklist: go mod tidy succeeds with a real Go version
Start server, open http://localhost:9000 — dashboard loads with stats
Connect via MCP — verify all 18 tools are listed
Call remember tool — memory is stored
Call search_memory — results have non-zero scores
Call recall_sessions — returns results from ~/.claude/ if sessions exist
Call list_sessions — lists discovered session files
Call global_search via MCP — returns cross-repo results
Create 130+ turn session — verify turn IDs don't corrupt

H3 — fix session FTS delete order (5 minutes)
M1 — nil guard on MemoryServiceFromContext (5 minutes)
M2 — fix turn ID generation (2 minutes)
B2 — register 6 missing MCP tools (45 minutes)
M4-M5 — export and watcher fixes (15 minutes)
